notes: StarPRNT of receiptline's starsbcs command set. No unknown items: ESC SP, the right side character spacing, is rendered since section 16c, and ESC RS a, ESC GS ETX and ESC s, the print start control, the status and the printer setting of receiptline's setup, are parsed. receiptline writes the Code 128 of ESC/POS as the code set selection {C and the value of every digit pair, one byte each, and the one of StarPRNT as the digits themselves; the renderer reads {C the way the specification describes, so both draw the same symbol, see the notes of section 16. Reviewed against receiptline's SVG preview of the same document.
